name: ai-game-dashboard
description: AI Game Dashboard - A unified platform to access multiple AI-powered games

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n "Dashboard,五子棋,马里奥,AI计算,终极数学" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm run serve" "npm run dev:wuziqi" "npm run dev:mario" "npm run dev:calc" "npm run dev:ultramath"
